popular.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
popular.plot: After a virus outbreak leaves the Canary Islands as Europe’s last refuge, a team heads to the mainland on a mission to find vital supplies. A man with questionable intentions joins them, and the operation becomes a desperate fight to survive amid infected hordes and growing divisions within the group.

popular.title: Wildwood
popular.plot: A young girl and her classmate enter a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries. They face a desperate quest to rescue her abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman.

popular.title: Project Hail Mary
popular.plot: A science teacher wakes aboard a spacecraft light-years from home with no memory of how he got there. As his memories return, he learns that a mysterious substance is causing the sun to fade, and he must use his scientific knowledge and inventive thinking to find a way to protect Earth.

popular.title: Resident Evil
popular.plot: A medical courier is caught in a terrifying outbreak during one chaotic night and must fight to survive as danger closes in. Far from a trained action hero, he faces increasingly frightening encounters while trying to make his way through the crisis.

popular.title: The Dark Knight
popular.plot: As a masked crime fighter and his allies work to dismantle Gotham’s criminal organizations, the city begins to see a fragile path toward justice. Their efforts are challenged by a dangerous criminal mastermind whose campaign of chaos tests the limits of their partnership and their beliefs.

popular.title: Heart of the Beast
popular.plot: After a plane crash leaves a Special Forces officer and his combat dog stranded in the Alaskan wilderness, they must rely on each other to endure the harsh conditions and find a way through. Their journey is a rugged test of survival, shaped by danger, exhaustion, and the deep bond between them.

popular.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
popular.plot: A full-time crimefighter faces the loneliness of living in a world that no longer remembers him, while watching old friends move on without him. As his powers begin to change in ways he can’t control, he must confront a dangerous threat to the city and the people he cares about.

popular.title: Hope
popular.plot: In a remote South Korean harbor village, a police chief and his officers investigate a mysterious creature causing destruction in the community. As the threat grows, confusion and human conflict make it increasingly difficult for the residents to understand what they are facing.

popular.title: Coco
popular.plot: A young aspiring musician struggles against his family’s generations-old ban on music. After a mysterious turn of events takes him to the vibrant Land of the Dead, he teams up with a charming trickster on a journey to understand his family’s past and find a way home.

popular.title: Verity
popular.plot: A struggling writer takes a ghostwriting job for a bestselling novelist who is unable to work after an accident. While staying at the novelist’s home to study her notes, she discovers unsettling material and begins to question what is happening within the household.

popular.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
popular.plot: During a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground. Surrounded by dizzying heights and exposed, dangerous paths, they face increasingly difficult odds and must fight to survive with little room for error.

popular.title: The Mongoose
popular.plot: A falsely accused war veteran with little left to lose sets off on a televised cross-country car chase, with police in pursuit. Former members of his military unit help along the way, while a fascinated public follows the journey and hopes he can reach safety.

popular.title: The Awakening
popular.plot: An elite military unit enters a South American jungle on a mission and encounters a deadly supernatural force. As the group faces an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain, the mission becomes a confrontation with a threat rooted in the jungle.

popular.title: A Story of Derry
popular.plot: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

popular.title: The Hotel New Hampshire
popular.plot: Beginning in the 1950s, an unconventional family pursues a life in the hotel business, running establishments in New England and Vienna. As the years pass and unexpected events reshape their lives, the family faces a strange, often unsettling mix of hardship and humor.

popular.title: Collision Course
popular.plot: In Spain in 2013, a bank robbery takes a dangerous turn when the getaway ends in a crash. As the thieves deal with the fallout, betrayals and lies reveal that their conflicts began long before the heist.

popular.title: The Odyssey
popular.plot: After the Trojan War, a legendary king sets out on a perilous journey home. He faces divine interference, mythological creatures, and trials that test his cleverness and humanity, while those waiting for him at home face troubles of their own.

popular.title: Buddy
popular.plot: In a colorful children’s-show world, a group of kids sing, dance, and follow a cheerful orange unicorn who promises to spread happiness. When one child refuses to join in, the show’s sunny routine begins to fracture, revealing a more unsettling reality beneath its cheerful surface.

popular.title: La Bola Negra
popular.plot: Three men living in different eras are connected by sexuality, desire, pain, and the legacies that shape their lives. Their intertwined stories explore how intimate experiences can echo across time and link people separated by generations.

popular.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
popular.plot: A young mother raising her daughter in her childhood home discovers she can enter a mysterious realm called the Further. There, she has an unusual ability to bring its inhabitants into the real world, drawing her into a frightening struggle to protect her family.

upcoming.title: Victorian Psycho
upcoming.plot: An eccentric young governess arrives at a remote Gothic manor, where a string of unsettling events leads the household to question her identity. As suspicion grows, the truth appears more dangerous than anyone expects, placing the residents in an increasingly disturbing situation.

upcoming.title: Confession
upcoming.plot: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

upcoming.title: Eternal Return
upcoming.plot: After losing someone she deeply loved, a young woman becomes emotionally closed off and abandons her former dreams. A chance meeting with a cartographer introduces her to magical maps connected to meaningful moments, prompting a journey through memory, loss, and the possibility of opening her heart again.

upcoming.title: Unbroken: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
upcoming.plot: A classical Chinese dance company rises from modest beginnings to international stages while facing intimidation, smear campaigns, and threats of violence. Through performers’ personal stories, the film explores how demanding training, spiritual conviction, community, and cultural revival sustain artists when their work collides with political pressure and questions of freedom.

upcoming.title: Prima Facie
upcoming.plot: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

upcoming.title: Paper Tiger
upcoming.plot: Two brothers chase the American dream, only to be pulled into the violent, corrupt world surrounding the Russian mafia. As their pursuit intensifies, danger and hard choices quickly close in.

upcoming.title: Zeta
upcoming.plot: When former intelligence officers are assassinated around the world, a covert operation from decades earlier resurfaces. A top operative must protect the only known survivor while investigating the killings, joined by an elite Colombian agent whose knowledge of the operation may be deeper than expected.

upcoming.title: The Loneliest Man in Town
upcoming.plot: A reclusive blues musician lives alone in an apartment packed with memories while life outside moves on. When the building is marked for demolition, the looming loss forces him to face the past and rekindles a long-buried dream.

upcoming.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
upcoming.plot: A 16-year-old artist creates striking drawings and sculptures while facing a difficult effort to leave Iran and reunite with her mother in Austria. Strong-willed and determined, she pursues a safer future through her art and an uncertain journey.

upcoming.title: Dear Lara
upcoming.plot: A violinist challenges powerful institutions within the classical music world after uncovering abuse and complicity. Her pursuit of justice brings wider attention to entrenched misogyny, institutional failures, and the systems that allow abuse to persist within elite musical circles.

upcoming.title: Heysel 85
upcoming.plot: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

upcoming.title: Fogaréu
upcoming.plot: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

upcoming.title: Josephine
upcoming.plot: After a young child witnesses a violent crime in a city park, she starts lashing out as fear and confusion take hold. Her parents struggle to help her feel safe again while navigating a difficult search for justice and the strain the trauma puts on their family.

upcoming.title: To Hold a Mountain
upcoming.plot: In Montenegro’s remote highlands, a shepherd mother and daughter fight to protect their ancestral mountain from becoming a military training ground. Their struggle also brings painful memories of violence that changed their family back into focus.

upcoming.title: Elsinore
upcoming.plot: A gifted actor takes on the demanding role of Hamlet while facing a serious illness and uncertain prospects. Determined to keep performing despite concerns about his health, he draws on wit and resolve, while his work becomes a source of inspiration and comfort to those around him.

upcoming.title: Fantasy
upcoming.plot: Mihrije, Sina, and Jasna are best friends in their early twenties who live in Slovenia. They are tomboys and refuse to conform to the conservative system they live in. Their world turns upside down when they meet Fantasy, a transgender woman. Together, they embark on a journey that explores the complexities of gender, desire, and self-discovery.

upcoming.title: Tristes Tropiques
upcoming.plot: A tight-knit group of young killers, trained under a feared ruler in the rainforest and tied to a shadowy organization, sets out on a revenge mission. As they push forward, mistrust and tension within the group threaten to unravel their plan.

upcoming.title: A Good Little Soldier
upcoming.plot: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.

upcoming.title: Congo Boy
upcoming.plot: Bangui, Central African Republic. 17 year-old Robert dreams of a career in music, but civil war is tearing the country apart. When both his parents are thrown into prison, he is left to look after his four younger siblings on his own, juggling daily life, odd jobs, school exams and concert stages, determined to follow his dream.

upcoming.title: The Fox
upcoming.plot: In a darkly comic folktale, a friendly foxhunter meets a shape-shifting fox who promises a chance to remake his partner into an idealized version. As he considers the offer, the temptation of power grows, pulling him toward a risky bid to dominate the natural world.

kids.title: Coco
kids.plot: A young aspiring musician struggles against his family’s generations-old ban on music. After a mysterious turn of events takes him to the vibrant Land of the Dead, he teams up with a charming trickster on a journey to understand his family’s past and find a way home.

kids.title: The Wild Robot
kids.plot: After a shipwreck leaves an intelligent robot stranded on an uninhabited island, she must adapt to its wild surroundings. As she gradually bonds with the animals, she takes on the challenge of caring for an orphaned baby goose, discovering new ways to connect and belong.

kids.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
kids.plot: A restless ruler of Halloween Town discovers a festive new world and becomes fascinated by its traditions. Hoping to bring that holiday spirit home, he sets a plan in motion, while a thoughtful rag-doll companion worries that his good intentions may lead to trouble.

kids.title: Forgotten Island
kids.plot: Two high school graduates and best friends are transported through a mysterious portal to a fantastical island filled with magical creatures. To find their way home, they must face a difficult cost tied to the memories that bind them, while seeking help and a way to leave before their friendship slips away.

kids.title: Coyote vs. Acme
kids.plot: After years of failed gadgets in his pursuit of a speedy bird, a determined coyote takes a bold new route: bringing the Acme Corporation to court. With help from a struggling lawyer, he faces a legal battle that mixes cartoon chaos with questions of fairness and corporate power.

kids.title: Toy Story 5
kids.plot: When a young girl becomes absorbed in a new tablet, her toys find it harder to hold her attention. The group faces a new challenge as they try to help her reconnect with playtime, navigating changing habits and the place technology has in a child’s life.

kids.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
kids.plot: Two Brooklyn plumber brothers are transported through a mysterious pipe into a magical world, where they are separated. One brother sets off on a fast-moving quest to reunite with the other, encountering colorful new places and familiar challenges along the way.

kids.title: La Leyenda del Charro Negro
kids.plot: On the way back to a family home, a young hero is misled by a dark legendary figure, causing an innocent girl to be pulled into the underworld. With help from loyal friends, he must set things right and escape before the danger grows.

kids.title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
kids.plot: An enthusiastic explorer accidentally unleashes an ancient spell, setting off a new adventure with his girlfriend and friends. Together, they face the consequences of the magic lamp while searching for a way to put things right.

kids.title: Minions & Monsters
kids.plot: A group of mischievous little creatures make their way into Hollywood and become movie stars, only to lose their success and unleash monsters through their filmmaking antics. With chaos spreading, they must work together to try to undo the trouble and save the planet.
